public_rationale: There is evidence that Huang was tightening financing terms before his departure. That supports part of Zitron's reasoning. But tighter terms do not by themselves establish that the financing model was ending. Reuters also reported continuing financing discussions without an indicated pause. The broader claim remains unsettled.
limitations: The relevant negotiations were private; accessible evidence is reporting rather than complete company records.
Reading 'coming to an end' as merely becoming more selective would produce a more favorable assessment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: NVIDIA's circular financing era was ending regardless of whether Jensen Huang remained CEO.

statement.excerpt: While the cries to restore Jensen Huang have fallen on deaf ears, even if he were to return, it’s clear that the circular financing era was coming to an end regardless of who was wearing the leather jacket.

from_speaker: the circular financing era was coming to an end
regardless of who was wearing the leather jacket
even if he were to return
our_interpretation: Circular financing means NVIDIA investing in customers or guaranteeing their financing to support purchases of NVIDIA products.
The ordinary reading is that this financing model was winding down, not merely that individual deals were receiving more scrutiny.
The context places the change between Huang's October remarks and the November 17 post.
Evidence of retrenchment under Huang can support independence from his departure, but cannot establish what every possible successor would do.
criteria.support_condition: Dated evidence shows a broad withdrawal from new customer investments and financing backstops already underway under Huang and continuing through the leadership transition.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated evidence shows the financing model continuing broadly unchanged, or shows that its withdrawal began solely because Huang departed.

evidence.excerpt: In October, Huang told those partners to get their customers to pay upfront.
evidence.locator: Paragraph discussing August financing changes and October customer prepayments
evidence.explanation: This supports the narrower point that financing terms were tightening under Huang. It reports an instruction, rather than measuring a broad withdrawal of investments and guarantees.
